title: CLEAR and Disney’s “Hexed” Team Up to Help Families Enjoy the Magic of Stress-Free Holiday Travel
summary: CLEAR is teaming up with Disney's Hexed to Surprise CLEAR+ Members with Free Future Bookings of CLEAR Concierge for Stress-Free Holiday Travel.
body_markdown:
Family trips can be overwhelming, especially during the holidays—bigger crowds, heavier bags, and more unknowns throughout the travel day. Our data shows that winter is the most popular time of year for family travel, and with Thanksgiving approaching, a helping hand through the airport can make all the difference for those flying with kids.


That’s why CLEAR is teaming up with Disney’s “Hexed”, in theaters November 25, to help families enjoy a stress-free travel day with CLEAR Concierge. Together, we’re gifting families that speed through security in the CLEAR+ Lane over Thanksgiving a free future booking of CLEAR Concierge, so they can experience the *magic* of a travel day with their own personal airport concierge.


##
A Collaboration Built Around Family Travel


In Disney’s “Hexed”, Billie and her mom, Alice, find themselves at the center of a magical adventure. Their mother-daughter relationship puts family at the heart of the story.


That shared focus on families is why we are so excited about this collaboration. Hexed tells a story about a mother and daughter facing the unexpected together, while CLEAR is dedicated to helping families enjoy a stress-free experience from home to gate and back again.


##
Bringing the Collaboration to Life


Families traveling through the CLEAR+ Lane from November 18–27, 2026, will receive a complimentary booking of CLEAR Concierge for a future trip. Terms apply, and CLEAR Concierge is available at select airports.


Travelers may also see the collaboration across CLEAR’s social channels, email, digital media, and select airport placements. “Hexed”-inspired activity sheets and messaging will appear in select CLEAR+ Lanes during the campaign, as well.


Together, CLEAR and Disney’s “Hexed” are helping Members experience a more joyful travel day on their holiday trips.


##
Stress-Free Family Travel with CLEAR Concierge


CLEAR+ Members can book[CLEAR Concierge](https://www.clearme.com/clear-concierge) for Departure Service or Arrival Service. For departing flights, your family’s personal airport concierge will meet you at the curb when you arrive, help with your bags and check-in, and bring you straight through security and to your gate or lounge.


For Arrival Service, your dedicated CLEAR Ambassador will greet you at the gate when you land, help with your bags, and bring you to ground transportation or your connecting flight. Availability depends on the airport and flight timing.


Especially during peak holiday travel season, this extra set of hands through the airport can turn a stressful travel day into a pleasant experience.


##
A Meaningful Collaboration for Our Members


CLEAR is dedicated to helping you enjoy seamless travel from home to gate, so you and your family can focus on what matters most. This collaboration reflects CLEAR’s mission, as together with Disney’s “Hexed”, we are bringing the *magic* of a stress-free experience to families across the country when they need it most.[‍](https://www.clearme.com/clear-concierge)


[Learn more about CLEAR Concierge](https://www.clearme.com/clear-concierge) , and see Disney’s “Hexed” in theaters November 25. *‍*


*Offer Terms: Families traveling together through the CLEAR+ Lane from November 18–27, 2026, will receive a complimentary future CLEAR Concierge booking. CLEAR Concierge is available at select airports. Terms apply.*
